sources.snippet: In contrast, CoLaR advances auto-regressive latent reasoning by introducing a novel next com-pressed embedding objective. This allows the model to capture the semantics of multiple word tokens within a single latent variable and reason with dynamic chain lengths, leading to improved efficiency and performance.
